title: I Shot You First: Networking the Gameplay of Halo: Reach
summary: Bungie's David Aldridge explains the networking programming behind Halo: Reach in a 2011 GDC session. It covers how gameplay stays in sync online, including forecasting and state reconciliation.
why: HN considers it one of the best game networking talks, with insights that carry over to distributed systems generally.

quote.text: This talk from the Halo: Reach team might be one of my favorite game networking talks I've ever seen
